'''Azurion''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Ignisnap]] at 6 iridescent moons after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

Unlike the other two "starter" Tatari, Azurion requires a higher star level to evolve to its final stage.

==Overview==
Current Description: "The flame on Azurion's tail grew alongside boundless curiosity, and you can always spot one circling around camp in barely contained excitement."

Azurion is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A bipedal, red lizard with a fiery tail and tan underbelly/chin. It has dark brown irises, blue pupils, and a blue tongue. Its feet are orange and yellow, and it has orange accents bordering its underbelly. It also has yellow horns, and blue horns from the sides of its face to the back of its head.

Azurion's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with pink.

== Evolution Trial ==
Azurion's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 iridescent moons/229 copies. To evolve it into [[Newflamander]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* In [[Island Goldrush]], use Energy Drink x20,000.
* Shoot 40,000 pinballs.

== Trivia ==
* Its original bio used to say: "If Azurions could evolve further, they'd grow wings, soar through sky, and try to destroy Camelot."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'Azurions might look like baby dragons, but even when max-evolved, they wont grow wings and fly.'--- 3-Step Trainer Guide"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Always full of energy and utterly carefree, Azurion's tail-licking joy spreads to any Tatari nearby."
